processors.name: Apple Speech Recognition
processors.data: Short voice-question audio when the Apple fallback is used
processors.purpose: Ask Noum voice transcription; processing location depends on Apple's service and device availability

processors.name: Apple Core Location / MapKit
processors.data: Device coordinate when you request nearby-club search; a location passed to Apple geocoding for Path daylight only when permission already exists
processors.purpose: Nearby-club results and a cosmetic local day/night scene; iOS controls the location ultimately supplied

processors.name: Google Vertex AI (Gemini)
processors.data: Speech transcript or Ask Noum message, bounded recent turns, bounded coaching context and session evidence, and selected video frames only when a production feature explicitly supports and requests visual feedback
processors.purpose: Production generated coaching and conversation responses

processors.name: Google Sign-In
processors.data: The SDK vendor declaration covers linked account and device data when Google Sign-In is used
processors.purpose: Authentication and vendor-declared service diagnostics; Noum does not use it for advertising or cross-app tracking

processors.name: Firebase (Google)
processors.data: Bounded production coaching requests and Authentication and App Check proof; account identity and optional sync data are processed separately for account functionality
processors.purpose: Protected callable transport and abuse protection for cloud coaching, plus authentication, optional sync, and vendor-declared diagnostics

processors.name: Open-Meteo
processors.data: A city or region label inferred from device time zone and locale, or supplied by app configuration; then coordinates returned by Open-Meteo itself
processors.purpose: Conversation weather context; Noum does not send a Core Location coordinate or account identifier
